What changed, and why

Preview quality

Was

44 px preview with little room to inspect text or QR.

Now

76 px centered preview, 152 px inspection view, preserved aspect ratio and visible loading state.

Clearer controls

Was

Native template filenames, generic Add actions and tightly packed picker controls.

Now

Product template names, specific custom-label actions, clearer search/filter structure and a distinct USB panel.

Responsive behavior

Was

A wider sheet could squeeze the picker beside the app sidebar.

Now

Two columns begin at xl; narrower layouts stack cleanly and retain the review shortcut.

Verification

  • 76 focused tests, TypeScript, touched-file lint and npm run build:app pass.
  • Dialog name, Escape/focus return, all custom generators, preview centering and four viewport sizes passed browser checks without page errors.
  • USB and CSV regression browser checks pass after refinement.
  • 1024 px viewport with 256 px sidebar space retains a 434.83 px picker title column and unclipped Add controls.
  • Normal preview PNG bytes are identical before and after refinement. The earlier integrated physical label was user-approved.

Things to know

  • Local source only; no commit, push or deployment. Authenticated feature-route proof remains open.
  • The UI refinement changes display sizing and controls; it does not change the approved printer bitmap.
  • Matched receipts establish retained-source/image provenance, not authenticated server behavior.
